hook.line: Don't start vibe-coding with Claude Code unless you've installed these four plugins.
hook.visual: Top half: terminal typing git commands over 'don't vibe CODE YET'; bottom half: presenter at a desk with a green lamp; the Claude logo flashes at 1.5 s.

beats.what: Split screen: terminal animation over 'don't vibe CODE YET', presenter below
Cut to a dark panel with the Claude logo forming
'50%' token cut with a bar chart
Rocket emoji with 'The second Omni Route' title
Provider grid screenshot, '353 AI providers', above the presenter
Animated 'Switching model...' card from one model to the next
Pixel robot mascot in a hard hat stands on a terminal window for 'doesn't waste tokens'
Portrait of the skills pack author, then the skills table

characters.who: Pixel-art orange robot in a yellow hard hat
characters.enters: Already standing on top of a terminal window when the shot cuts in
characters.acts: Stands as a visual stand-in for the Graphify agent that reads the code base
characters.exits: Hard cut to the next plugin's card

why_it_works: Negative callout ('don't vibe code yet') stops Claude Code users who fear they are doing it wrong
A new visual every 2.5 s (logo cards, charts, UI) keeps the eye busy through a dense list
Hard numbers on screen (50%, 300 providers, 1.6 billion tokens) make each item feel worth saving
Each plugin opens with an ordinal title card, so the list is easy to follow muted
weaknesses: Loud music bed at about the same level as the voice competes with the narration
Big claims (unlimited usage, 1.6 billion free tokens) are not shown being tested
The presenter is on screen only 38% of the time, so it feels like a faceless slideshow
for_robert: The pixel mascot appears once and is gone; give Fred a running role across items and bring him back for the final line.
